item.title: Daily News for Wednesday, August 12, 2026
item.description: Today's thread is AI operationalizing into the exact industries you sell into — and the governance questions that follow it. Anthropic stamping watermarks into Claude output worldwide, and two chatbots each crossing a billion users, together tell you generative AI is now default ...
